## Highlights

- Show the current SQLite database file size in weekly, monthly, preview, and range reports.
- Show signed byte growth or shrinkage since the last successfully delivered report of the same type. The first weekly or monthly report shows the change as unavailable.
- Save size history only after successful weekly or monthly delivery, so failed sends remain pending without establishing a false comparison.

## Upgrade notes

Stop collection and reporting, back up the SQLite database, update the code or container image, and restart. The first writing command migrates SQLite `user_version` from `6` to `7` and adds a table for delivered report sizes. No configuration or RouterOS changes are required.

To roll back to `v0.1.5` after migration, stop all processes and restore the pre-upgrade database backup. The older version rejects schema version `7`; do not manually downgrade `user_version`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Raposo93/mikrotik-report/compare/v0.1.5...v0.1.6
